testsuite.name: Delete a transaction from transaction log

testcase.name: Delete button is displayed
Warning dialog appears before deletion
Warning dialog content and options are displayed
User cancels the deletion
Cancelled transaction still appears in the list
User confirms the deletion of a transaction
Deleted transaction is not retrievable via search, filter or sort
Deleting the only remaining transaction empties the log
Deleting a transaction keeps the active filter or search applied
Deletion flow is uniform across all transaction categories
